description: c115 re-author: --launch-mp-room base:arena_mp_felicity base:combat 4 seeds g_MatchConfig pre-mainProc and arms post-CI main-menu auto-open (g_PostExitMainMenuView=0). Test verifies the seeded match config and main-menu auto-open landing. Drives nav via mixed action injection (ACTION_USE / ACTION_MENU_DOWN focus-independent) and SDL keys (Escape) to walk through to the Room and exercise MP_SETUP / MP_ADVANCED / MP_BOT_SETUP back-edges. FINDING: SDL key events with windowID=0 (from smokePushKey) are filtered out by ImGui_ImplSDL2_ProcessEvent's windowID guard at imgui_impl_sdl2.cpp:400, which silently drops arrow keys / Return / Escape from ImGui's nav. ACTION-injection bypasses windowID but the menu nav cursor stays put because pdguiDriveImGuiNav reads actionHeld, not actionPressed, and a one-frame tap may not survive ImGui's nav repeat delay. This test currently locks the boot fast-path as regression coverage; deeper menu nav requires a windowID fix in smokePushKey or an actionPressed-mode in driveHeld.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --launch-mp-room seeds g_MatchConfig + 4 bots and arms g_PostExitMainMenuView=0 so Main Menu auto-opens on first CI frame. --main-menu reinforces the same arm. Main menu opens with focus on row 0 = Solo Play (per s_MainMenuEdges in menugraph.c).

input_sequence.name: ACTION_MENU_UP
input_sequence.comment: Main Menu auto-opened at boot. Cursor restoration may land on row >= 1; ACTION_MENU_UP x10 to guarantee top-of-list (no-wrap). Note: ACTION-injection bypasses both SDL/ImGui windowID filtering AND focus state; cursor still requires ImGui to consume the synthetic AddKeyEvent in pdguiDriveImGuiNav.
